source:
flowchart LR
  start[Receive] --> check{Valid?}
  check -->|Yes| publish[Publish]
  check -->|No| reject[Reject]

flowchart TB
  subgraph pipeline[Data pipeline]
    ingest[Ingest café ☕] --> transform[Transform Δ]
  end
  transform --> store[(Store)]

sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant API
  participant Store
  Client->>API: Submit request
  activate API
  API->>Store: Save record
  Store-->>API: Saved
  API-->>Client: Accepted
  deactivate API

classDiagram
  class Document {
    +String title
    +render()
  }
  class Page
  Document "1" *-- "many" Page : contains

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Draft
  Draft --> Review : submit
  Review --> Published : approve
  Review --> Draft : revise
  Published --> [*]

gantt
  title Release plan
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  section Build
  Implement :done, a1, 2026-09-01, 3d
  Verify :active, a2, after a1, 2d
  section Ship
  Release :milestone, after a2, 0d

journey
  title Documentation journey
  section Author
    Write content: 5: Author
    Review preview: 4: Author, Reviewer
  section Publish
    Release site: 5: Maintainer

mindmap
  root((ProDockit))
    Author
      Markdown
      Diagrams
    Publish
      HTML
      PDF

timeline
  title Project history
  2024 : Prototype
  2025 : Adoption
  2026 : Standalone rendering

gitGraph
  commit id: "Initial"
  branch feature
  checkout feature
  commit id: "Worker"
  checkout main
  merge feature id: "Release"

quadrantChart
  title Reach and engagement
  x-axis Low reach --> High reach
  y-axis Low engagement --> High engagement
  Campaign A: [0.30, 0.60]
  Campaign B: [0.75, 0.80]

xychart-beta
  title "Monthly builds"
  x-axis [Jan, Feb, Mar]
  y-axis "Builds" 0 --> 100
  bar [20, 55, 80]
  line [10, 40, 70]

packet-beta
  title Network header
  0-15: "Source Port"
  16-31: "Destination Port"
  32-63: "Sequence Number"

C4Context
 title System Context diagram
 Person(user, "User")
 System(system, "System")
 Rel(user, system, "Uses")
